purpose_context: Readers and agents meet domain terms throughout the docs with no shared definition at hand. M4 turns a single Contextive glossary file into browsable per-context glossary pages and auto-links the first use of each term per section, with hover previews and an auto per-page references block, so the site teaches its own vocabulary while authors maintain one file that also powers their IDE.
purpose_tldr: A multi-context project glossary that auto-links domain terms across the docs, sourced from a Contextive definitions file.
